superseded_validation.reason: An initial green focused run was superseded after independent source inspection identified and corrected two ownership-boundary defects. No gate claim relies on the earlier binaries.

audits.scope: CRLF, strict UTF-8, no BOM, and final CRLF for the 19 implementation and decision text files in this slice
tamper-evident event ledger through the checkpoint event

independent_review.scope: dashboard response composition, static assets, compact/full telemetry frames, latest-value broadcaster, prepared-exchange closure, tests, and CMake layering
initial_findings: The frame-pair factory retained caller-supplied shared byte vectors after one size check, allowing a retained mutable alias to alter or resize published data.
The prepared SSE exchange accepted any non-null type-erased subscription without revalidating its advertised finite 1-to-2 Hz delivery rate.
corrections: The frame-pair factory now accepts caller vectors by const reference, validates them before allocation, and deep-copies both into private shared immutable storage; regression coverage mutates and resizes both caller buffers after construction.

The subscription interface owns the inclusive 1 and 2 Hz constants, and SSE exchange creation validates finite in-range delivery before publication while closing rejected ownership exactly once; finite out-of-range, infinity, and NaN cases are covered.
independent_review.post_correction_result: Independent source-only confirmation found neither issue remaining and found no other concrete layering, bounds, response-composition, broadcaster-lifetime, static-store, or CMake discrepancy in this slice.

behavior_proved: complete response composition reserves the entire 16,384-byte header ceiling and rejects bodies above 2,080,768 bytes without truncation
GET response bodies are owned independently, HEAD responses advertise the would-be representation length without a body, and shutdown actions remain one-shot and forbidden on HEAD
JSON rejections preserve approved headers and replace malformed, oversized, or unsupported internal metadata with one fixed small 500 response

static assets are validated once, sorted by canonical path, retained as shared immutable handles, bounded to 128 entries, 8 MiB aggregate, and 2,080,768 bytes per asset, and shell mappings form a closed four-identifier set

compact SSE events preserve the realtime system surface, retain the first eight process rows and newest twenty history points, and omit Forge and power detail while full events preserve the complete existing schema
one producer snapshot becomes one shared compact/full frame pair whose private bytes cannot be changed through retained caller buffers after validation

the broadcaster admits at most 32 subscriptions, seeds each mailbox, validates its 1-to-2 Hz delivery rate, stores only the newest pair, signals bounded ready edges outside locks, and signals a replacement sink once for an already-pending pair
per-connection delivery cadence selects compact bytes for delivered frames 1 through 9 and full bytes for frame 10, with null takes and replaced unsent frames excluded from the cadence
broadcaster moves retain live subscription ownership, close is idempotent, concurrent publish/take/close races preserve capacity one, and shutdown does not wait for an in-flight ready signal
the prepared exchange revalidates type-erased subscription rate and closes invalid finite or nonfinite implementations before publication
